title: DIY Sleep Apnea Fix Update: What We’ve Learned
summary: Essential Craftsman follows up on his earlier video about a DIY approach to sleep apnea. It centers on forcing nose breathing during sleep with mouth taping and nasal strips, and says to seek medical guidance.
why: HN people mention it as where they first heard of mouth taping and DIY CPAP-style fixes for sleep apnea.

quote.text: Essential Craftsman on Youtube is where I first heard about mouth taping
